title: Tokens with more than 18 decimals are not supported
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The current design of the `amountToSD()` and `amountToLD()` functions limits compatibility to tokens with 18 or fewer decimals. If a DAO is created using a token with more than 18 decimals as the `depositTokenAddress`, the DAO creation will fail due to an underflow issue during the `convertRate` calculation. While this poses no financial risk, it restricts the factory's adaptability within the broader DeFi ecosystem, preventing its use with such tokens.
